idea-plugin.name: Code Scroll
idea-plugin.description:
Oh, just another code minimap: the whole file in your theme's colors next to the code, with errors, changes and bookmarks marked on it. Drag the frame to scroll, or rest the pointer on the map to see the code under it.

The map marks what you would otherwise go looking for:

  • errors and warnings, VCS changes, bookmarks and breakpoints;
  • every occurrence of the selected text and the current search results;
  • TODO, FIXME, region and MARK comments and class names, as labels you can read.

Rendered Markdown previews get a map of their own, and scrolling with it moves the source too. Colors come from your color scheme, so light and dark themes each keep theirs, and you can set your own in Settings | Editor | Color Scheme | Code Scroll. Everything else is in Settings | Editor | Code Scroll.

Code Scroll is free and open source under the MIT license. It collects no data and never goes online.

Made by Oh, just another!, a team of one. Bug reports go straight to the entire staff.
